topic: Creating specs before coding - decomposing requirements that span several independently testable capabilities into a capability map of modules before specifying

subtopics.scope: Activation triggers (new project, ambiguous requirements, multi-module change, architectural decision, over 30 minutes) and the explicit when-not-to-use list; single-capability requests skip Phase 0.
seed_queries: when to write a specification before coding software project
spec-driven development when documentation upfront is needed

subtopics.scope: Phase 0 scope check: detecting bundled capabilities, proposing a capability map (module table, stable kebab-case ids, dependency direction without cycles, build order), gating the map, then recursing per module with SPEC-<id>.md files.
seed_queries: decompose requirements into modules capability map software design
module decomposition dependency direction build order software architecture

subtopics.scope: Phase 1 specify: surfacing assumptions immediately before writing spec content, asking the human clarifying questions, never silently filling ambiguous requirements.
seed_queries: surfacing assumptions in software requirements gathering
clarifying questions before writing software specification

subtopics.scope: The six core spec areas (objective, commands, project structure, code style, testing strategy, boundaries with Always/Ask first/Never) and the full spec template including tech stack, success criteria and open questions.
seed_queries: software specification document template sections testing strategy boundaries
project specification document tech stack commands code style structure

subtopics.scope: Reframing vague requirements as concrete, testable success criteria so loops and retries target a measurable goal.
seed_queries: writing testable acceptance criteria from vague requirements

subtopics.scope: Phase 2 plan (components, dependencies, implementation order, risks, parallelism, verification checkpoints, tasks/plan.md) and Phase 3 tasks (session-sized, acceptance criteria, verification steps, dependency order, 5-file cap, task template).
seed_queries: software implementation plan dependency ordered task breakdown
vertical slicing task decomposition acceptance criteria

subtopics.scope: Phase 4 implement one task at a time via incremental-implementation and test-driven-development, loading spec sections on demand with context-engineering; the canonical-source relationship with planning-and-task-breakdown and the api-and-interface-design boundary.
seed_queries: test driven development incremental implementation workflow
context engineering loading relevant code sections AI agent

subtopics.scope: Keeping the spec alive (update on decision or scope change, commit it, reference it in PRs), the seven common rationalizations, the red flags list, and the pre-implementation verification checklist.
seed_queries: living specification document version control keep updated
